champion.tips: DRAVEN TIPS AND TRICKS If your Axe Q drops in the open and the enemy has skill shots or CC, don’t pick up the Axes Q if it will put you in danger. When you have hundreds of stacks of Adoration, play a little safer and request assistance from your Jungler or Mid laner to cash out. When trading with the enemy, make sure you watch your positioning, the enemies position and the Axe Q drops. Try and make sure you pick up your Axe’s Q as you can to deal extra damage in the trade.
champion.builds: THE BEST DRAVEN BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR BOT IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Draven Bot build, you should take Flash and Barrier as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Lethal Tempo as your keystone, followed by Presence of Mind, Legend: Alacrity and Last Stand in the primary tree, as well as Absolute Focus and Gathering Storm in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Bloodthirster as your first item, followed by Berserker's Greaves and The Collector. For your last 3 items, you should build Infinity Edge, Lord Dominik's Regards and finish with Rapid Firecannon. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - W - E. Right now, this build has 53.4% winrate over 12 221 matches played. Optional Your second option for Draven Bot build would be to take Flash and Barrier as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Press the Attack as your keystone, Presence of Mind, Legend: Alacrity and Last Stand in the primary tree, and Absolute Focus with Gathering Storm in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense. The items for the build are Bloodthirster, which you should build first, followed by Berserker's Greaves as your second item and The Collector as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Infinity Edge, Lord Dominik's Regards and Rapid Firecannon. The skill order for this build is Q - W - E. In the current patch, this build has a 49.8% win rate over 2 163 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Barrier as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Lethal Tempo as your keystone, Presence of Mind, Legend: Alacrity and Last Stand in the primary tree, and Absolute Focus with Gathering Storm in the secondary tree, as well as Attack Speed, Adaptive Force, and Health as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are The Collector as your first item, then Berserker's Greaves as a second item and Infinity Edge as a third item. You want to finish the build with Lord Dominik's Regards, Bloodthirster and Immortal Shieldbow. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - W - E. This build is currently sitting at a 51.6% win rate across 1 778 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Draven Bot build in the current patch, try Flash and Barrier as your Summoner Spells, Lethal Tempo, Presence of Mind, Legend: Alacrity and Last Stand as your primary rune tree, and Absolute Focus with Gathering Storm as your secondary tree. Use Attack Speed, Adaptive Force and Health as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Hubris as your first item, then finish Berserker's Greaves as your second item, and The Collector as third item. The last 3 options are Lord Dominik's Regards, Infinity Edge and Bloodthirster. The ability order for this build is Q - W - E. As of the current patch, this build has a 54.8% win rate over 1 483 matches played. Situational Draven Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Draven build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Draven runes page.
